findings.text: The frozen branch substitutes locked_membership, a fractional area value computed from selected fragment area, for the current read's membership; this freezes a continuous booking quantity rather than only the cut-cell set and makes Newton corrections solve a stale-area residual while geometry moves.

The drift and acceptance checks compare only the cut-cell and normal-form masks, although :1619-1624 also freezes fragment_selected; when the selected fragment changes within the same cut cells, the solver can accept without the required unfreeze and extra fresh step.

item_verdicts.diff: Read the 25 commits from 8e86ede37 through 8890aefcd and their 14-path diff against 62e8ba8; the solver, tests, measurements, evidence fragment and figure all stay in the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: The source prompt's FENCE — EVIDENCE requires the diverted 550-cell solve, analytic and own-lane precision, one H200 allocation with 1/16-slice walls and counts, and sirius CPU tests; h200-oracle-final.log:4-24 and cpu-committed-head.log:20 record those measures.
item_verdicts.goal: The source prompt's goal is a one-program bank solve with factor reuse and a frozen active set; nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:1473 adds solve_batch and :1740 adds solve, while :1615 and :1689 leave the frozen-set contract incomplete.
item_verdicts.manifest: The reviewed run's manifest.md reports 25 commits, the final H200 receipt, six passing CPU tests, and baseline_suite/after_suite with the same two failing IDs; the named logs confirm those summaries.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The source prompt:103-108 grants support_read.py, test_bank_solve_driver.py, the bank_solve_driver prototype directory, and its evidence and figure paths; git diff 62e8ba8..8890aef lists only those 14 paths.

justifications.durability: tests/test_bank_solve_driver.py:99-100 fail on scalar flags, :135-139 on false convergence, wrong refactor counts, extra Jacobian builds or uniform lane steps, :171-173 on cap misreporting, :260 and :356-360 on failed fresh solves or independent precision budgets, :377 on failed reuse variants, and :390-392 on failed freezing or convergence, while measure.py:127,189,196-198,223,230,293-301 reject wrong dtype and analytic or own-lane breaches; :138 compares two counters advanced together and no assertion forces changed fragment selection or moving fractional membership.
justifications.evidence: h200-oracle-final.log:4-24 records 0.658 s single and 1.869 s per slice at sixteen lanes with all residuals below 1e-10, while cpu-committed-head.log:20 records six passes and the paired suite logs have identical two-failure sets.
justifications.fit: nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:1473 extends the module that owns read_batch, newton_step and step_residual, follows its JAX NamedTuple and lax.while_loop idiom, and introduces no prohibited plan-labelled source name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:1473-1769 supplies the staged loop, batch refactor branch and capped fresh residual, but :1615 freezes fractional occupancy and :1689 omits fragment-selection drift.
justifications.reuse: nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:1473 and :1740 extend the bank read and Newton owner; a capability search found nova/equilibrium/solve.py:48 and :122, but that generic JVP-based pure-map solver cannot preserve this module's analytic bank Jacobian and fresh topology read.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 62e8ba872fde49906c90e234a4ea0c2e478e150c..8890aefcd78a4ffc0bdde274a6b0a4b5649b6422 touches exactly the 14 paths granted by the source prompt:103-108.
